name: Buon Ma Thuot Prison
kicker: French-built prison kept as a heritage site
summary: The yellow French-built prison at 18 Tan Thuat, kept as a revolutionary heritage site: arched blue doors, tiled roofs, and barred cell blocks around a bare yard. Give it 45 minutes in the morning. Skip it when the Y Ngong museums already have your morning.
getThere: 18 Tan Thuat, a short taxi from the center
heroCaption: Yellow block with three blue doors
body: Nhà đày Buôn Ma Thuột is the French-built compound at 18 Tan Thuat, in Tu An, preserved as a revolutionary heritage site. The buildings are the visit: yellow walls, arched blue doors under tiled roofs, and long cell blocks with barred windows facing the yard.
Go in the morning, the easier hour, and give it 45 minutes. Dak Lak Museum and Bao Dai Palace at 02 Y Ngong are a separate stop on their own tickets, so pick one for the morning if time is short.

figures.caption: Cell doors and barred windows along the side block
figures.alt: Yellow cell block with green doors and barred windows at Buon Ma Thuot Prison

gettingThere: The compound is at 18 Tan Thuat, in Tu An. From the hotels around Nguyen Tat Thanh and Le Duan it is a short taxi or Grab ride.

legs.heading: From the city center
legs.body: A short taxi or Grab ride.
